# Outcome-measurement corpus fixtures

These JSONL bytes are sanitized derivatives of real local measurement inputs,
not hand-invented host formats.

- `gate-2026-08-03.sanitized.jsonl` derives from the first JSON object in the
  live `gate-2026-08-03.log`. Request identity, project identity, evidence
  identifiers, and nested evidence content were replaced or removed. Key order,
  JSONL encoding, scalar types, and the observed pre-protocol field shape were
  preserved.
- `codex-rollout-2026-07-29.sanitized.jsonl` derives from one real Codex rollout's
  `session_meta`, `function_call(latch_gate)`, and matching
  `function_call_output` records at source rows 1, 416, and 418. The path,
  request, result content, call ids, and session ids were sanitized. The
  captured `Wall time`/`Output:` wrapper and nested external text-result
  encoding remain structural; only their content is sanitized. The real record
  was historical/pre-nonce, so the fixture remains pre-nonce rather than
  inventing a nonce.
- `claude-transcript-2026-07-22.sanitized.jsonl` derives from the real Claude
  transcript rows 21-22 containing `mcp__latch__kb_gate` `tool_use` and its
  matching `tool_result`. Request/path/identity/prose were sanitized while the
  top-level message blocks, nested text result, and historical skipped verdict
  shape were preserved. It intentionally remains pre-nonce/pre-v2.6.
- `manifest.json` pins every fixture byte hash and records its source category,
  source date, record coordinates, and sanitization classes. It excludes its
  own hash to avoid a recursive manifest.

The golden report is generated by the public `measure()` path and pre-envelope
`compute_oracles()` arithmetic. Its current-protocol S1/S2 bytes are structural
mutations/minimizations of the captured historical byte shapes and traverse the
same snapshot, segmented parser, preliminary receipt, and evidence-fold path;
no current-protocol external record is claimed to have existed historically.
`audit()` is reserved for a complete contract/capture/manifest/fixture/canary
envelope and therefore is not used to manufacture a fixture before that
envelope exists.
The local-only conformance test separately inspects the unsanitized roots when they
exist and asserts non-zero corpus floors without printing their contents.
